ambiguities.text: The index page only shows file structure without specific implementation details.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Use known EIP specifications: EIP-1884 for gas repricing, EIP-1344 for CHAINID, EIP-1884 for SELFBALANCE, EIP-152 for BLAKE2b.

ambiguities.text: Interaction between SLOAD gas increase and access lists (future EIP-2930) not addressed in Istanbul.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Istanbul SLOAD pricing applies uniformly to all storage accesses without warm/cold distinction (that comes in Berlin fork).

implicit_assumptions.description: Existing contracts relying on SLOAD costing 200 gas may fail or become more expensive after Istanbul.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts with tight gas budgets for storage operations will encounter out-of-gas errors.

implicit_assumptions.description: The CHAINID opcode correctly returns the canonical chain ID for the network.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect chain ID would defeat replay protection, allowing transaction replay across chains.

implicit_assumptions.description: BLAKE2b precompile implementation is constant-time to prevent timing side channels.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Variable-time execution could leak information about the inputs being processed.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot exploit the low gas cost of SELFBALANCE (5 gas) for DoS attacks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Cheap repeated SELFBALANCE calls could be used for spam or denial of service.
